verdict_text: NO. The merge formula is computed against a moving base rather than the fixed base: the script computes `tmp = b + λ(f1-b)` then `out = tmp + λ(f2-tmp)`, which expands to `0.36·b + 0.24·f1 + 0.4·f2`, not the required `out = b + λ(f1-b) + λ(f2-b) = 0.2·b + 0.4·f1 + 0.4·f2`. This is exactly the ordering hazard the spec calls out — each task vector must be taken against the unmodified base — and it violates Required Result clause 2's formula, producing values well outside the 1e-5 relative-Frobenius-error tolerance in grading.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
